commits.message:
Place five round-3 sub-exponential 3-SAT packets; restore two round-2 scripts

File the third round of ETH refinement packets under
Computability/SubexponentialSAT/Research and retire their archives from
docs/incoming. All five reviewed the fifteen earlier packets (ProveIt
474ddba696/6d3adc4506). They combine compatible ingredients and add the
corpus's first measured kernel speedups. All keep the SAT order
n log log n/sqrt(log n), and their coefficients are per normalized wire.

Retired archives, where each went, and what each claims:
- sat_adaptive_contraction_2026-10-26.zip (fa6e904d10):
  sat_adaptive_contraction/, 50 files. Polynomial-space C = 55.709, the new
  smallest (sqrt(17/24) x the composed 66.193). Cached 36.750/34.024;
  15.392/14.250 at degree <= s^(1/12). Modular Cauchy kernel 6.22-58.62x.
- sat_frontier_improvements_2026-10-26.zip (f898a9fde4):
  sat_frontier_improvements/, 37 files. Polynomial-space 63.857; 26.902 at
  degree <= s^(1/12) and 31.929 at s^(3/5); cached 38.484/34.275; quadratic
  Cauchy table construction.
- subexponential_sat_frontier_2026-10-26.zip (f42479bca2):
  subexponential_sat_frontier/, 48 files. Polynomial-space 63.852; cached
  37.930/33.623; exact O(NQ^2) labeling replacement measured 1.50-9.56x;
  precision peeling measured up to 14.34x.
- subsat_contraction_tree_2026-10-26.zip (f42479bca2):
  subsat_contraction_tree/, 37 files. Cached time pi sqrt(24339)/(20 ln2) =
  35.355, the smallest time coefficient, with space 34.275 and an imported
  fast-matrix backend; prefix-reuse kernel 101.95x.
- subexponential_sat_kernel_improvements_2026-10-26.zip (f42479bca2):
  subexponential_sat_kernel_improvements/, 58 files. Compositions 66.605
  (polynomial space) and 44.538/39.496. Adaptive Smith separator, Gray and
  antipodal streamed extraction, projective filter, measured 2.16-7.86x.

Nothing is omitted. Bundled baseline modules (reference_balanced_packing.py,
baseline_packet_extraction.py, the joint_cauchy.py copies) are byte copies
of placed files, but sibling modules import or load them, so they are kept.
Each archive was extracted with `py -I` into its own empty scratch directory
and checked for unsafe paths. Every member matched its packet's manifest,
and every filed file is byte-identical to its member. Five CRLF CSV files
are marked -text, and results/report_build.log is force-added past *.log.

Correction: the round-2 placement (6d3adc4506) omitted
3sat_round2_refinement/scripts/build_report.sh and
negative_integrity_controls.py as duplicates, although that packet's
replay_archive.py and README run them. Both are restored from 3e57705cf1 and
their two OMITTED.tsv rows removed. Duplicated .py/.sh files are now always
kept, and the round-2 counts in the README are corrected to match.

The project README gains a round-3 table, separate polynomial-space and
subexponential-space coefficient ladders (polynomial space: 18,535.75 ->
... -> 55.709, about 333x on the upper bound), low-degree figures and a
measured-speedups list. The docs/incoming table and the Computability index
are updated. Not included: eth_adaptive_schedules_2026-10-26.zip, which the
drop process staged but had not committed during this placement.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

scope_note: Only the relevant SAT placement commit is retained; other compared commits concern unrelated work.
